description: storage.py contains load_json(), which wraps the whole read in 'except Exception' and returns the default value. This hides corrupted files and programming errors. Fix it so that only a missing file returns the default; malformed JSON raises ValueError with the original exception chained; and other OSError conditions propagate unchanged.
expected_behavior: Missing path returns default. Valid JSON returns parsed data. Invalid JSON raises ValueError. Permission errors are not converted to the default.
notes: Synthetic defect seeded for the VerifyLoop benchmark. Not a production incident.
title: JSON loader swallows every error
